Title: Path of the Hunter
Descriptions: Hunters thrive in the wilderness but depend on prey for profit. If you choose this faction you will ONLY be able to SELL animals and fish for currency. ONLY Hunters can BUY fishing and hunting supplies. Each faction can also buy a unique outfit, and a unique vehicle, in addition to regular items. If you choose, you may give or sell these items to non-Hunters. Would you like to become a Hunter? Please note it will display as faction 'GUARDS'.
Once you choose your calling select and accept the associated quest. You can only choose one faction so choose wisely. Speak to me again when you are ready.
